verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a dedicated Payment Initiation product, the European Payments suite, which lets users make real-time bank payments from inside the app without typing account details, and it states its geography as 18 European markets ([plaid-docs-6], [plaid-docs-15]). A community comment corroborates that Plaid runs on PSD2/Open Banking rails in Europe ([plaid-comm-14]). Auth supplies account and routing numbers for ACH or wire, but that only supports payments the developer runs elsewhere; it is not Plaid initiating them ([plaid-docs-1]). Missing for 10: an explicit per-country list of live markets, endpoint-level detail on the initiation flow and payment status, hands-on corroboration of a payment being initiated, and any evidence of pay-by-bank initiation outside Europe.
